title: Class 4 spheres seen only during restricted government activities

tellings.quote: Um, class 4 is a sphere. Um, we only saw this several years in a row, when we saw class 4.

plain: Skywatcher, a startup that says it can call up UFOs, describes a kind of object it calls "class 4": a sphere that it says its team saw only while restricted government activities were going on nearby. Speaking as witnesses in their interview with Michels, the Skywatcher team says they saw it over several years in a row, which would suggest these spheres turn up only around certain government work.
